SELECT m.* FROM t_media_movie m LEFT JOIN t_media_metadata md ON md.id = m.metadata_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId}
AND m.directory_id = #{directoryId}
AND ( m.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR md.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR md.original_title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR md.overview ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array(md.genres, ',')) AS g(genre) WHERE trim(g.genre) = #{genre} )
ORDER BY md.release_date ASC NULLS LAST, m.id ORDER BY md.release_date DESC NULLS LAST, m.id
ORDER BY md.vote_average ASC NULLS LAST, m.id ORDER BY md.vote_average DESC NULLS LAST, m.id
ORDER BY COALESCE(md.title, m.title) ASC NULLS LAST, m.id ORDER BY COALESCE(md.title, m.title) DESC NULLS LAST, m.id
ORDER BY m.create_time ASC NULLS LAST, m.id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC NULLS LAST, m.id
